svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Deck 1000 x 450: plywood, faced with 3 mm HDPE glued and screwed.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Nine riffles, HDPE strip 6 wide, 8 tall, glued along the deck,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 60 in from the front edge, then every 38 to the back; each

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: starts 30 later than the one in front (60, 90 ... 300 from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: head end) and all stop 40 short of the far end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Feed box 180 x 90 x 70 at the back of the head end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Wash pipe: 40 mm PVC, 770 long, 3 mm holes every 25 toward the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: deck, along the back edge from 190 to 960; end cap; hose tail.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pitman cheeks: two steel plates 40 x 22 x 6 under the head end,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 12 mm apart; a slot 12 wide, 20 long along the table for the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: pitman pin (8 mm of free play toward the far end, for the stop).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: deck flat within 1 mm; riffles straight and well stuck.
